## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
summary(cars)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.

```{r}
# app.R

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)

ui <- fluidPage(

  titlePanel("Fixed Effect vs Random Effect Simulation"),

  sidebarLayout(

    sidebarPanel(

      sliderInput(
        "fixed",
        "Fixed effect difference between groups:",
        min = 0,
        max = 30,
        value = 10
      ),
      helpText(
        "Fixed effect: controls the systematic difference between predefined groups. ",
        "Increasing this value separates the mean scores of Group A, B, and C."
      ),


      sliderInput(
        "random",
        "Random effect SD (e.g., hospital/rater variation):",
        min = 0,
        max = 20,
        value = 5
      ),
      helpText(
        "Random effect: controls variability among sampled random levels ",
        "(e.g., raters or hospitals). Higher values indicate greater between-level variation."
      ),


      sliderInput(
        "error",
        "Residual error SD:",
        min = 1,
        max = 20,
        value = 5
      ),
      helpText(
        "Residual error: individual-level unexplained variation. ",
        "It represents measurement noise and within-group variability."
      ),


      sliderInput(
        "n",
        "Observations per group:",
        min = 10,
        max = 100,
        value = 30
      ),
      helpText(
        "Controls sample size. Larger samples produce more stable estimates of group means."
      )

    ),


    mainPanel(

      plotOutput(
        "plot",
        height = "600px"
      ),

      hr(),

      h4("Model structure"),

      p(
        "Y = μ + Fixed effect + Random effect + Residual error"
      ),

      p(
        "Fixed effect: predefined groups (e.g., treatment/site/metric)."
      ),

      p(
        "Random effect: sampled levels from a population (e.g., rater/patient/hospital)."
      )

    )
  )
)



server <- function(input, output, session){


  dat <- reactive({

    set.seed(123)


    # Fixed effect:
    # Three predefined groups
    groups <- tibble(
      Group = c("A", "B", "C"),
      Fixed = c(
        0,
        input$fixed,
        2 * input$fixed
      )
    )


    # Random effect:
    # Five sampled levels from a population
    random_effect <- tibble(
      RandomGroup = paste0("R", 1:5),
      Random = rnorm(
        5,
        mean = 0,
        sd = input$random
      )
    )


    # Generate observations
    expand_grid(
      Group = groups$Group,
      RandomGroup = random_effect$RandomGroup,
      id = 1:input$n
    ) %>%

      left_join(
        groups,
        by = "Group"
      ) %>%

      left_join(
        random_effect,
        by = "RandomGroup"
      ) %>%

      mutate(

        Score =
          50 +
          Fixed +
          Random +
          rnorm(
            n(),
            mean = 0,
            sd = input$error
          )

      )

  })



  output$plot <- renderPlot({

    ggplot(
      dat(),
      aes(
        x = Group,
        y = Score,
        color = RandomGroup
      )
    ) +

      geom_jitter(
        width = 0.15,
        alpha = 0.35,
        size = 2
      ) +

      stat_summary(
        fun = mean,
        geom = "point",
        size = 5,
        color = "black"
      ) +

      theme_classic(
        base_size = 14
      ) +

      labs(

        title = "Fixed Effects + Random Effects Simulation",

        subtitle =
          "Black dots = fixed group means | Colors = random-effect deviations",

        x = "Fixed-effect groups",

        y = "Observed outcome"

      )

  })

}


shinyApp(
  ui = ui,
  server = server
)
```
